product_one_liner.value: Aviso AI is an AI-powered revenue platform that helps go-to-market teams forecast revenue, prioritize deals, automate sales workflows, and retain customers.

pricing_page.notes: The pricing URL is a request-for-proposal form, not a published plan catalog; no prices or distinct purchasable plans are listed.

named_customers.notes: Explicitly identified as early adopter customers; this is not a claim that every customer remains current.

founded_year.notes: The company explicitly states founded in 2012; 2014 was its public launch from stealth.

eng_blog.notes: Technical ML posts by Aviso data scientists Harshit Agarwal and Sherin Thomas cover RAG/fine-tuning and the platform’s use of fine-tuned open-source versus closed-source models.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The published openings include Data Engineer, which does not qualify, but no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.value: OpenAI/GPT; Llama 3; Qwen; DeepSeek R1; proprietary Aviso models.

compliance_certs.notes: GDPR is described as an internal compliance assessment, not a certification. PCI DSS Level 1 appears in an AWS-linked infrastructure statement, not an unambiguous Aviso certification claim.

last_funding.notes: Latest reported round: January 5, 2022; corroborated by funding-history databases, rather than an original company announcement.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest reported round is January 5, 2022, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Account Executive opening covers remote USA and Canada.

launched_6mo.notes: AI CSM launched June 16, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On February 4, 2026, Aviso announced Al Arun as EVP, Professional Services, Customer Success, and Adoption.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Documented product integrations; this does not establish which CRM Aviso uses internally.
